title: Island map, straight down
caption: A north-up, straight-down version of the picked island map for the builder to re-register the overlay and re-trace the layout on. Buildings sit on their footprints; nothing was redesigned.

sections.title: Before and after
sections.caption: Left: the picked map with the landmarks we check. Right: the top-down version with the same landmarks at their ground points.

images.caption: Pink: ground the leaning buildings hid in the picked map (15% of the land). It is filled as plain paving and lawn, so don't trace paths or buildings from it.

sections.title: Every attempt, in order
sections.caption: One change per attempt. The roof moves are the same in all of them; only the fill of the hidden ground changes.

images.caption: The picked map through the ground-plane fit the map code uses (REF). Roads and coast land right; every building leans north over its own footprint.

Each of 76 buildings traced once, plus the monorail beam (outline plus how far it sits above its base) and moved down onto its footprint, then rectified. Magenta: ground the leaning buildings hid in the picked map. Grey: outside the picked picture.

Holes and outside filled by Flux 2 Klein 4B, masked, 4 steps, reference latent, seed 101. Prompt: "Straight top-down view ... Flat grey and white rooftops, paved paths and small plazas, round tree canopies, lawns, blue sea around a rocky coast." It drew new roofs and blue blobs in the holes.

One change: prompt without rooftops ("Paved footpaths, small paved courtyards, lawns and round tree canopies between the buildings; open blue sea around a rocky coast."). Still blue blobs and new grey shapes.

One change: RDBT Anima with the LLLite inpainting-v2 patch, denoise 1.0, 30 steps, cfg 5, seed 101, prompt: quality tags, safe, "top-down view, overhead view, from above, map, scenery, no humans, paved footpaths, small paved courtyards, lawns, round tree canopies, blue sea, rocky coast". Blends better but invents domes, lawns, a round building in the dorm court and islets in the sea.
One change: holes start from the nearest open ground (never a roof), blurred. At denoise 1.0 it makes no difference.
One change: denoise 0.75. The sea is clean, the holes still get pools and domes.
One change: denoise 0.55. The blurred grey start turns into round tanks. Worse.
No model: holes continued inward from their edges (OpenCV Telea). Nothing new is drawn, but it smears into stars.
One change: Anima inpaint over the Telea fill, holes only, denoise 0.4. Holes read as paving and lawn; a few wall-like blocks in the north.
One change: denoise 0.3. No new buildings; the hidden ground is plain paving and lawn.
Picked. Same as 11, with the monorail beam traced in 20 px steps (no stair-steps) and the ground its lean hid filled with sea instead of paving.
One change: a light Klein img2img over the whole of 12 (8 steps, last 25%). Almost no visible change, so 12 stays.
